title.zh: 【Securitize 集成 ADI Chain 以拓展机构代币化业务】
title.en: 【Securitize 集成 ADI Chain 以拓展机构代币化业务】

current_state.zh: Securitize is integrating ADI Chain into its multi-chain ecosystem so its regulated tokenized financial products can use ADI Chain infrastructure, which also settles the IHC/First Abu Dhabi Bank dirham stablecoin DDSC.
current_state.en: Securitize is integrating ADI Chain into its multi-chain ecosystem so its regulated tokenized financial products can use ADI Chain infrastructure, which also settles the IHC/First Abu Dhabi Bank dirham stablecoin DDSC.
